svg.title: How Fusion HCI comes together
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Built at the factory: IBM pre-selects the servers, switches and rack, and pre-configures the system on day one. One dashboard: CPU, memory, storage and network use across the OpenShift cluster, in one view. Updates, no downtime: Redundant parts update and restart one at a time while the system keeps running. From IBM’s Fusion HCI data sheet.
